method: Existing native Canvas procedural art; no input images edited, generated or acquired. No new sprites or runtime drawing passes. Fissures baked once into the mirrored chaos painting; sanctuary slab gloss baked once into its floor and elliptical reflected light baked into the existing sanctumFlow atlas frame.

chaos.method: 24 fixed-seed short branching paths, about 24-72 pixels long, luminous 1.15px core with 4.8px soft halo at 1024 resolution, no holes, paths avoid all wrap edges. Base painting remains unchanged.

sanctuary.method: Directional broad specular and narrow sheen clipped to each slab, beneath its corner ornaments. Soft ellipse reflected illumination in existing counter-rotating flow sprites. Existing 6 sources/18 sprites normal and 2/2 lite budgets retained.
